name: Extensions, Themes and Core Update Manager
author: Chetan Vaghela

sections.description:
Extensions, Themes and Core Update Manager provides a centralized interface for managing WordPress update behavior.

The plugin allows administrators to disable update checks for plugins, themes, WordPress core, and automatic updates when required for development, testing, or controlled deployment environments.

It is especially useful for websites where updates are managed manually or through external deployment workflows.

Features

  • Disable plugin update checks.
  • Disable theme update checks.
  • Disable WordPress core update checks.
  • Disable automatic updates.
  • Simple and lightweight settings page.
  • Easy configuration without editing code.

Use Cases

  • Development and staging environments.
  • Websites using custom deployment workflows.
  • Sites where updates are managed manually.
  • Prevent unexpected automatic updates during testing.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open WP Disable Updates from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Configure the update options according to your requirements.
  5. Save the settings.
sections.faq:
What updates can be disabled?

The plugin can disable update checks for plugins, themes, WordPress core, and automatic updates.

Is this plugin intended for production websites?

It is primarily intended for development, staging, testing, or websites that use managed deployment processes. Carefully consider your update strategy before disabling updates on a production website.

Can I re-enable updates later?

Yes. Simply change the settings to restore the default WordPress update behavior.
